nodes.label: ddd Project Specification
nodes.rationale: v2 spec revised after adversarial review. Defines the architecture, document model, sync, server, plugin system, Flutter shell, deployment, build order, and known risks for the ddd project.

nodes.label: Vision (Microkernel Document Manager)
nodes.rationale: Everything is a document (one markdown file). Everything else is a plugin. The core provides CRDT-synced storage and a plugin runtime. Plugins share state through documents, not custom channels.

nodes.label: Architecture Overview
nodes.rationale: Four-layer stack: Flutter shell (optional), React PWA (microkernel + shared Rust core as Wasm), Rust server (REST + WebSocket + Wasm plugin host), MongoDB. Server's identity is to keep replicas converging and clients in step.

nodes.label: Document Model
nodes.rationale: A document is one text file with three regions: frontmatter (YAML), body (markdown), machine sections (%%% fences). CRDT is one Y.Text. Humans own frontmatter, machines own their %%% section. Parsing is strict YAML subset with hardening caps.

nodes.label: Sync & Offline
nodes.rationale: Projection + lazy CRDTs model: every document readable/searchable offline via replicated projection; full Y.Docs hydrate lazily for editing. Local query engine with shared Wasm filter evaluator. WebSocket transport with backpressure and reconnect.

nodes.label: Rust Server
nodes.rationale: axum + tokio + mongodb + yrs + extism. REST API for scripts/integrations. Auth via argon2id with session cookies or bearer tokens. Shared workspace: any user can edit/delete any document, with audit log.

nodes.label: Plugin System
nodes.rationale: Plugins are first-order citizens. Backend is Extism Wasm with capability-gated host functions. Frontend is React ES modules with versioned @kernel surface. Base distribution includes shell-ui, router, commands, themes, search, doc-list, folders, markdown, document-surface, viewer, editor, properties, settings, admin.

nodes.label: Flutter Shell (Android)
nodes.rationale: Webview serving downloaded bundle from local storage. Bearer token auth. Bundle updater with verification and auto-revert. Capability bridge (filesystem, scheduled local notifications). Webview storage backed by native data directory.

nodes.label: Repo, Deployment, Operations
nodes.rationale: Monorepo. Production: Kubernetes single-replica. Local/self-host: Docker Compose. Health/metrics endpoints. Graceful shutdown. CSP. Offline app shell with Workbox. Backups via mongodump or admin export. No telemetry.

nodes.label: Build Order (Milestones)
nodes.rationale: M1: Server core with CRDT. M2: Sync with projection replication. M3: Microkernel frontend with base plugins. M4: Backend plugins with Extism. M5: Flutter shell with webview, updater, bridge.

nodes.label: Known Risks
nodes.rationale: Markdown-syntax merge artifacts, %%% same-key concurrency, plugin trust, single-replica server, Flutter shell effort/verification, blessed runtime pinning, client-registry-dependent task semantics.
